notes: Family review report (Reports > Family review) rebuilt for the kitchen table: printing now gives clean full pages instead of one clipped scroll box (works on phone too). New sections: Where it went (spending by bucket vs the period before), Where we shopped most, Bills and subscriptions (with a yes/cut tick box on paper), Where the money came from, and Biggest single expenses (one per vendor). New 'What we agreed' notes box at the bottom - type your decisions, they save automatically and print inside the report; the next review shows 'Last time we agreed' so you can check whether you kept them. Every row still clicks through to its transactions.
